lines: I realize the screaming pain
Hearing loud in my brain
But I'm going straight ahead with the scar
"It's fine if you forget it all, fine if you stop feeling"
I put a lid on my scraped-up heart
"It's okay to get hurt, there's no more pain anyway"
Even while dragging those feet along
my lost self
crumbled away with a sound
Before I knew it, only the wind remained...
I've come to tell you, following the trail of scars
before the world crushes me down for good
Do you remember, that sky of tears?
That pain was what protected you
That pain is always protecting you
Can you hear me?
So am I
"Not the strength to stay unharmed, but the kindness that never hurts"
That voice sounded sad somehow
Like a button fastened in the wrong hole
my heart and body drifted apart
Once more, take hold of your heart
I've come to tell you, following the trail of scars
before the world crushes me down for good
Do you remember, that sky of tears?
That pain was what protected you
That pain is always protecting you
That crying voice I heard once
was without a doubt my own
It was all for this moment
I must have known from the very start
Never again let go of yourself
You noticed it — the sign I sent you
That pain was what protected you
I've come to tell you, following the trail of scars
that if so, there's nothing left to fear
Don't forget, the reason for your smile
That pain was what protected you
That pain was what protected you
That pain is always protecting you
